$description: Text roles (Plenix Styling Standard, section 6; owner, 2026-10-20: one uniform type system): each role is six separate tokens, --plx-sys-text-<role>-font-family, -font-size, -font-weight, -letter-spacing, -line-height and -word-spacing, each pointing to an existing token (#372 step 3: written by hand, so plain Style Dictionary writes the same custom properties as build-tokens.js; a W3C typography composite is not used, because its word spacing would need an extension and plain Style Dictionary writes no composite). A role sets the metrics (size, weight, letter spacing, line height) in DM Sans; Reddit Mono is not a role but a switch, text-mono-font-family with text-mono-word-spacing, that any role takes for a technical value or code. A component that establishes a role applies all six (the two font properties from the role or from the Mono switch); one that adjusts a role sets only the properties its contract names.

text-body-font-family.$description: Running text: the page's body text. The text-body role's font family.

text-body-word-spacing.$description: The text-body role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-secondary-font-family.$description: Supporting text one step below the body: descriptions, metadata in words. The text-secondary role's font family.

text-secondary-word-spacing.$description: The text-secondary role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-caption-font-family.$description: The smallest running text: captions, hints, help under a field. The text-caption role's font family.

text-caption-word-spacing.$description: The text-caption role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-label-font-family.$description: A label: names a field, a group or a value. The text-label role's font family.

text-label-word-spacing.$description: The text-label role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-heading-font-family.$description: A section heading inside a page or a card. The text-heading role's font family.

text-heading-word-spacing.$description: The text-heading role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-title-font-family.$description: A page's title. The text-title role's font family.

text-title-word-spacing.$description: The text-title role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-eyebrow-font-family.$description: A small spaced label above a heading. The text-eyebrow role's font family.

text-eyebrow-word-spacing.$description: The text-eyebrow role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-display-font-family.$description: The largest style: one key figure or a sign-in heading. The text-display role's font family.

text-display-word-spacing.$description: The text-display role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-lead-font-family.$description: Body text one step up: the opening paragraph of a page. The text-lead role's font family.

text-lead-word-spacing.$description: The text-lead role's word spacing (the companion of the typography token).

text-mono-font-family.$description: The Mono switch (owner, 2026-10-20: one uniform type system): a technical value or code in any role takes Reddit Mono, fitted to DM Sans (size-adjust, platform/system/fonts.css), so it keeps the role's size, weight, line height and letter spacing and shares the baseline of the text beside it.

text-mono-word-spacing.$description: The Mono switch's word spacing: a space as wide as DM Sans's. Always set with text-mono-font-family.
